content.text: Coningsby discovers his mother’s miniature in a banker’s box and meets Edith Millbank in Paris. Misreading Sidonia’s friendship with Edith, he leaves, but later learns the truth. He and Edith fall in love at Hellingsley; Millbank forbids their marriage because of his feud with Lord Monmouth. Coningsby rejects his grandfather’s demand to contest Darlford, is disinherited, and enters the Temple to study law. After Millbank nominates him, Coningsby wins Darlford and marries Edith at Millbank; Flora later leaves him her fortune. Meanwhile, Lord Monmouth separates from Lucretia and dies, leaving his estate to Flora. A separate narrative follows pirate Captain Flint, who operates from a crystal cave with Lightfoot and Black Bill. Haunted voices and apparitions frighten the crew, while Flint plans further piracy and disguises attacks as the work of another pirate.
